title: Record every OPay payment in the POS sales table
summary: Every payment on your OPay business account, your POS terminals included, kept in your POS sales table with the fee and what was settled.
description: Whenever OPay reports a payment on your business account (a card paid on a terminal, a transfer to a terminal's account, a wallet payment), adds a row to your POS sales table with the terminal, the kind, the amount, OPay's fee, the amount settled to you, the day and whether it went through. The same table the Moniepoint recording workflow writes to, so the evening summary and cash-up cover both. Connect OPay Business once under Connections (Taskiem makes the key pair and shows where in the OPay dashboard to paste the public key and the webhook address). Nothing is sent to anyone.
